items.title: Is China Licensing Shift Altering The Investment Case For Starbucks (SBUX)?
items.summary: Starbucks reported past quarterly revenue of US$9,141.2 million, lower than a year earlier, while net income and diluted EPS were higher for both the quarter and full year. Management guided to about a 1% consolidated net revenue decline for fiscal 2027, tied largely to the China licensing transition and the 53rd week effect. items.title: 5 Big Funds Sold McDonald’s. Should You Follow Them Before Earnings?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFive funds cut or sold their McDonald’s stakes in Q2, and three of them sold every share, according to their latest 13Fs. Two of the sellers added Yum! Brands, Chipotle Mexican Grill and Starbucks over the same quarter, and all three trade at higher multiples than McDonald’s.
